note: A sheet set is what a job inspects against. Named by what it is, not by a code. `kind` tells the app which subject the sheet is about: a location (client/site/hazardous substance location), a handler (an applicant), or cylinders (a PCBU importing batches). `authorisation` points at the WorkSafe register entry that permits it. A set may instead carry `choices`, picked at job start: a section listed under a choice appears only when that choice is picked; a section listed under no choice always appears; `notInScope` sections are never assessed. A set is authorised when its `authorisation` resolves, or when it has choices and every choice's `authorisation` resolves; otherwise the app will not open a job on it. Why each section sits where it does: CHOICES.md.
